lines: “二品武魂，白玉战矛。”
随着魂官赞赏的声音响起，一名年仅十岁少年高兴地欢呼起来。
台下一片羡慕的目光。
今日是玄武城一年一度的觉醒日。
凡是年满十岁的少年少女全部聚集于此。
对他们来说，一旦成功觉醒，便能够成为一名武者，走上修炼的道路。
对大部分普通人来说，更是实现阶级跨越的唯一方法。
此时玄武城五大家族之一的江家队伍中，江尘看着一个又一个同龄人上台，心中已经紧张到了极点。
“迄今为止，穿越已有十年，今天终于到了觉醒日。”
“不知我会觉醒什么武魂？”
在这种人生重大事件中，纵使两世为人，江尘也很难保持平静。
“哥，我听见他们打赌，说你最多只能觉醒一品武魂，真是太可恶了！”
这时，妹妹江雪跑过来，指着大房江明和他的狗腿子，表情愤愤地说道。
江尘闻言看去，只见一个前方穿着华贵的少年对自己做了一个大拇指向下的动作。
江家大房与其他几房的关系并不好，小辈之间也多起争端。
尤其是江尘所在的二房，因为父亲江战早年外出任务受了重伤，修为尽失，剩下修为较低的母亲常婉茹，外加两个小的，就更容易受欺负。
若非江尘从小锻炼，在这群小的里面还算拔尖，早就被欺负得不成样子了。
“江明，你又想挨揍了？”
江尘撸起袖子，露出一对壮硕的膀子。
修炼界的孩子都是从小锻炼，为将来打基础。
江尘因为拥有上一世的记忆，心智成熟，锻炼起来也更加认真努力。
直到现在，就算不觉醒，实力也与一阶武徒相差不多。
江明见状顿时缩了缩脑袋，随后叫嚣道：“江尘你别嚣张，我已经找大师算过了，大师说我天资绝佳，将会觉醒十品武魂！”
“待我觉醒之后，必要把你的脑袋塞进茅坑里！”
这番恶心的话，顿时令江雪直翻白眼。
后方的长辈看着一群孩子，大房江旭挺着大肚子，捋捋胡须，细长的眼睛看向江战，假惺惺的笑道：“二弟，你家江尘从小便天资聪颖，武艺也远超同龄人，想必今日定会觉醒高品武魂吧！”
“高品武魂可遇而不可求，江尘若能觉醒三品我便心满意足了。”
江战苍白的脸上浮现出一丝笑意。
他被废之后，一家人在家族中的待遇便大不如前。
就连身为家主的父亲也对他越来越冷淡。
好在他还有个好儿子。
只要江尘觉醒出不错的武魂，获得家主的大力培养，就能让二房在家族中重新掌握话语权。
江家其他几房也议论着今日的觉醒。
content_en:
"Second-grade martial spirit, white jade war spear."
As the soul officer's voice of appreciation rang out, a ten-year-old boy cheered happily.
There were envious looks in the audience.
Today is Xuanwu City’s annual awakening day.
All boys and girls over ten years old gather here.
For them, once they successfully awaken, they can become a warrior and embark on the path of cultivation.
For most ordinary people, it is the only way to achieve class crossing.
At this time, in the ranks of the Jiang family, one of the five major families in Xuanwu City, Jiang Chen was extremely nervous as he watched his peers take the stage one after another.
"It has been ten years since I traveled through time, and today is finally the day of awakening."
"I wonder what martial spirit I will awaken?"
In such a major life event, it would be difficult for Jiang Chen to remain calm even though he had been a man for two lifetimes.
"Brother, I heard them making a bet that you could only awaken a first-grade martial spirit at most. It's really abominable!"
At this time, sister Jiang Xue ran over, pointed at the eldest brother Jiang Ming and his lackey, and said angrily.
When Jiang Chen heard this, he looked over and saw a young man in front of him who was wearing luxurious clothes and made a thumbs down gesture towards him.
The relationship between the eldest family of the Jiang family and the other families is not good, and there are many disputes between the younger generations.
Especially the second room where Jiang Chen lives, because his father Jiang Zhan was seriously injured on a mission in his early years and lost all his cultivation. He is left with his mother Chang Wanru, who has a lower cultivation level, and two younger children, so he is even more vulnerable to bullying.
If Jiang Chen hadn't been trained since he was young, and he was still the best among this group of youngsters, he would have been bullied to the point of disgrace.
"Jiang Ming, do you want to be beaten again?"
Jiang Chen rolled up his sleeves, revealing a pair of strong arms.
Children in the cultivation world are trained from an early age to lay the foundation for the future.
Because Jiang Chen has the memory of his previous life, he has a mature mind and works harder in training.
Until now, even if he has not awakened, his strength is about the same as that of a first-level warrior.
Jiang Ming immediately shrank his head when he saw this, and then shouted: "Jiang Chen, don't be arrogant, I have already gone to the master to settle the matter. The master said that I am extremely talented and will awaken the tenth grade martial spirit!"
"When I wake up, I will put your head in a pit!"
These disgusting words immediately made Jiang Xue roll her eyes.
The elders at the back looked at the group of children. The eldest brother, Jiang Xu, had a big belly and smoothed his beard. He looked at Jiang Zhan with his slender eyes and said with a hypocritical smile: "Second brother, your Jiang Chen has been very talented since he was a child, and his martial arts skills are far superior to those of his peers. I believe he will awaken a high-grade martial spirit today!"
"High-grade martial arts spirits can only be encountered but cannot be sought. If Jiang Chen can awaken to the third grade, I will be satisfied."
A smile appeared on Jiang Zhan's pale face.
After he was deposed, the family's treatment in the family was not as good as before.
Even his father, the head of the family, became increasingly cold towards him.
Fortunately, he also has a good son.
As long as Jiang Chen awakens a good martial spirit and gets strong training from the family leader, he can regain the right to speak in the family.
Other rooms in the Jiang family were also discussing today's awakening.
